items.description: Network discovery and port/service scanning. Standard in authorized network assessments. Scan only systems you own or are authorized to test.

items.name: OWASP ZAP
items.description: OWASP web application security scanner (DAST). For testing web apps you own or are authorized to assess.
items.install_command: brew install --cask zap 2>/dev/null || (sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y zaproxy)

items.name: sqlmap
items.description: SQL injection detection and testing. Use only against applications you own or have written authorization to test.
items.install_command: brew install sqlmap 2>/dev/null || pipx install sqlmap || pip3 install sqlmap

items.name: Nikto
items.description: Web server misconfiguration and known-vuln scanner. Authorized testing only.
items.install_command: brew install nikto 2>/dev/null || sudo apt-get install -y nikto

items.name: ffuf
items.description: Fast web content/parameter fuzzer for authorized web assessments.
items.install_command: brew install ffuf 2>/dev/null || go install github.com/ffuf/ffuf/v2@latest

items.name: OWASP Amass
items.description: Attack-surface mapping and subdomain enumeration (OSINT). For scoping assets you are authorized to assess.
items.install_command: brew install amass 2>/dev/null || go install github.com/owasp-amass/amass/v5/cmd/amass@latest

items.name: Trivy
items.description: Defensive scanner for container images, filesystems, and IaC — finds CVEs, misconfigs, and secrets.

items.name: Semgrep
